name: whetstone
description: Cross-platform agent skills, MCP servers, and tooling. Includes a video-production discipline stack (engine-agnostic + Remotion-specific + HyperFrames-lens skills).

interface.shortDescription: Cross-platform agent skills with a video-production discipline stack
interface.longDescription: Whetstone is a public, standards-based monorepo of agent skills. The headline package is a three-skill video-production stack: video-discipline (engine-agnostic 12 disciplines + 5-stage pipeline), video-remotion (Remotion-specific receipts), and video-hyperframes (thin lens over HeyGen's HyperFrames). Designed to work across Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and any MCP-aware agent client.
